units.function: Paperclip's customer-facing company export page: fetches preview/fidelity/entity ordering, computes category/file selection, filters preview YAML/README, browses package files and builds the final ZIP after a second server export call.
units.dependencyDirection: A 1,110-line React page directly coordinates auth/company contexts, four API domains, preference hooks, raw package parsing/transformation, ZIP creation, data-URL/Markdown preview, routing and presentation. Policy, transport, serialization and UI are tightly coupled.
units.keyDataModels: Full export preview/result/manifest/file maps, six category toggles, selected path Set, client-effective files, fidelity warnings, file-tree/search/pagination state and sidebar order.
units.lifecycle: Fetch session/entities/fidelity; generate full preview; derive selected files; rewrite YAML/README in browser for display/estimate; request a fresh selected export; synchronously ZIP server-returned files; trigger a browser download.
units.testAssessment: Focused jsdom Vitest passed 6/6 tests on 2026-08-19, with two expected jsdom navigation-not-implemented messages. Tests cover default selection, task/routine/blob toggles, file counts/size changes and fidelity-warning rendering. They do not cover blocker enforcement, auth/tenant failure, stale preview, package digest equality, errors, cancellation, large memory behavior, untrusted Markdown/MIME, keyboard/mobile flows or URL cleanup assertions.
units.designRationale: Offer a rich local package browser and category-level export customization while preserving user sidebar ordering and producing a downloadable ZIP without a separate download endpoint.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs an independently branded governed export experience where a human reviews one server-canonical plan/artifact, understands exact data/evidence loss and approves the same digest that is downloaded.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT in Company OS Web over a narrow versioned export-plan API. The server must canonicalize selection, render manifests/README, enforce authority/data contracts, stream/sign the artifact and bind preview, approval and download to one immutable digest. Adapt only file-tree browsing, responsive layout and category-summary interaction patterns.
units.responsibilityConflict: The page has no accountable-human approval, purpose/destination, responsibility/evidence category or action digest. Fidelity blockers remain actionable visual warnings, human responsibility is absent from regenerated README/org semantics, and English-text filtering hides warnings.

securityFindings: Preview and final export are separate requests with no source revision, selected-plan token or artifact digest binding.
Client rewrites YAML and README with custom parsers for preview/size, while final download uses fresh server-rendered files, so reviewed content can differ from downloaded bytes.
The custom YAML filter supports a narrow grammar and can diverge on duplicate keys, comments, multiline values, Unicode slugs or future schema extensions.
Generated README interpolates unescaped tenant strings into Markdown headings, blockquotes, tables and lists and stamps a nondeterministic client date.
Fidelity severity=blocker is rendered but does not disable export or require accountable acknowledgement/approval.
Warnings are hidden by matching English text rather than stable codes.
ZIP generation synchronously duplicates the entire selected bundle into ZIP bytes, ArrayBuffer and Blob on the browser main thread.
Artifact preview trusts package MIME/data URLs and renders untrusted Markdown without displaying verified digest, size or source-trust context.
Page state/effects are not clearly reset per company and suppress dependency checks, risking stale selection/preview during company or ordering changes.
Malformed percent-encoded deep links can throw during render; URL encoding is asymmetric for reserved characters.
